answer: Walnut Path-Length Quorum. Each agent earns routing weight only through short, reciprocal message paths to diverse peers. Enforcement: an identity whose neighbors' shortest path to the trusted core exceeds a threshold is throttled, and any cluster with unusually uniform neighbor overlap is quarantined. An attacker must sustain many distinct, low-overlap links with real round-trip latency, paying bandwidth, uptime, and a meadow-wide spread of persistent connections; a whisper of shared topology collapses the cluster.
